notes.title: Achievements have arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello there kind gamers,

I'm happy to announce, that Freddy Spaghetti has just received an update in which 55 Steam Achievements have been added.

There's an achievement for each of the 50 levels, along with 5 achievements for bonus levels.

If you have already completed a level/s, the achievement will unlock the next time you load the level.


Now then, get collecting!  :D


Until next time,
Yours Sincerely,
Dr Pasta

notes.title: Minor Fixes and Changes
notes.notes:
Well hello there my fellow gamers!

Thank you so much for all the support for Freddy so far, it truly warms my heart.


I've been noticing, from watching Youtube gameplay, that there are some issues regarding the game.

Minor bugs and things like text being too bright etc.  You might have been noticing tiny updates recently, that were sent out specifically to fix these issues.

In addition to this, I've also noticed some frustration regarding certain levels.  Look, a joke is a joke, but I feel bad about the torment that some of you had to go through.

So, I've also made some levels a bit easier.  The levels in question are 5-5 and 5-9.
If you found yourself putting the game aside because of these, I invite you to give it another go! :)

Freddy's story needs to be heard, in FULL...


That's it for now, but I'm still scouring the interwebs in an effort to provide the best possible experience for you wonderful folks!

Kind Regards,
Dr Pasta
